question: Which of these dances is commonly performed in Odisha ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ghumura**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ghumura A folk dance from** the Kalahandi district of Odisha.
 
• The d**ance's dress code is similar to a tribal danc**e, but some say the dance forms and mudras are more similar to other classical Indian dance forms. 
 
• The ghumura naat is said to be a combination of the Damru of Lord Shiva and the Veena of Goddess Saraswati. 
 
• The** Ghumura dance symbolizes victory over evil**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Folk dances**

 
 
• **Dalkhai:** A dance performed by young girls during festivals like Dussehra and Bhaijuntia 
 
• **Chaiti Ghoda:** A dance performed by fisherman tribes like the Keot, representing the Chaitri month 
 
• **Sambalpuri:** A traditional dance from western Odisha that incorporates tribal and rural influences 
 
• **Jhumair: **A folk dance from northern and western Odisha 
 
• **Dhap: **A Sambalpuri folk dance performed by the Kandha tribe of western Odisha 
 
 
 
• **Classical dances** 
 
 
• **Odissi: **A classical dance that originated in the Hindu temples of Odisha.
 
 
• It is based on the ancient Sanskrit text Natya Shastra.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Puppet dances **
 
 
• **Kandhei**: A puppet dance from Odisha
 
 
 
• **Other dances**
 
 
• **Chhau:** An ancient dance that originated in the Mayurbhanj district of Odisha 
 
• **Gotipua**: A dance that emerged from the Devadasi tradition 
 
• **Ruk Mar Nacha**: A dance that originated in the Mayurbhanj district of Odisha
